queues.title: Market identity and boundaries
queues.objective: Define platform functions, products, buyers and history

tasks.title: Identify the legal operator
tasks.acceptance: Public official evidence names the operator and date.

tasks.title: Classify all platform roles
tasks.acceptance: Separate selling, publishing, payment, discovery and contracting roles.

tasks.title: Map products and services
tasks.acceptance: Document permitted and excluded classes of offerings.

tasks.title: Define seller and buyer segments
tasks.acceptance: Describe who supplies and who pays in each segment.

tasks.title: Record changes in marketplace structure
tasks.acceptance: Cite dated launches, acquisitions and economic changes.

queues.title: Entry and eligibility
queues.objective: Understand who can participate and what it takes

tasks.title: Document onboarding
tasks.acceptance: Identify signup steps and eligibility documents.

tasks.title: Verify country and residency access
tasks.acceptance: Compare official rules by jurisdiction.

tasks.title: Record age, identity and tax requirements
tasks.acceptance: State requirements and their geographic scope.

tasks.title: Check thresholds and curation
tasks.acceptance: Document review processes, audience thresholds and approvals.

tasks.title: Measure time to earning eligibility
tasks.acceptance: Use official timings or dated samples with caveats.

tasks.title: Identify practical barriers
tasks.acceptance: Examine credentials, tools, languages and platform-specific conditions.

queues.title: Fees, costs and payouts
queues.objective: Trace receipts to usable earnings

tasks.title: List setup and publication costs
tasks.acceptance: Record mandatory, optional and recurring charges.

tasks.title: Find commissions and service fees
tasks.acceptance: State fee basis, rate, tiers and effective dates.

tasks.title: Separate payment processing charges
tasks.acceptance: Check transaction, currency conversion, refund and chargeback costs.

tasks.title: Check payout rails and countries
tasks.acceptance: Document payment methods and geographic availability.

tasks.title: Record withdrawal minimums and delays
tasks.acceptance: State payout minimum, frequency, holds and reserve policies.

tasks.title: Identify published tax obligations
tasks.acceptance: Document required forms, withholding and merchant-of-record terms.

tasks.title: Model a transparent net-sale example
tasks.acceptance: Calculate gross less documented fees with assumptions.

tasks.title: Build a dated fee and payout history
tasks.acceptance: Compare sourced changes without overwriting previous rules.

queues.title: Market size and demand
queues.objective: Measure buyers, sellers, segments and growth

tasks.title: Estimate reachable buyer populations
tasks.acceptance: Define geography, date and measurement method.

tasks.title: Estimate active versus total sellers
tasks.acceptance: Separate registered, listed, active and paid users.

tasks.title: Measure transaction or revenue scale
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish GMV, platform sales, revenue and payouts.

tasks.title: Identify meaningful product segments
tasks.acceptance: Use a reproducible category taxonomy.

tasks.title: Establish comparable growth series
tasks.acceptance: Compare consistently defined observations over time.

tasks.title: Assess market concentration
tasks.acceptance: Measure dependence on leading categories or sellers.

queues.title: Discovery and acquisition
queues.objective: Understand how demand reaches an offering

tasks.title: Document platform search and recommendation
tasks.acceptance: Cite discoverability surfaces, ranking documentation and limits.

tasks.title: Research evidence of query demand
tasks.acceptance: Record public demand signals and their sample limitations.

tasks.title: Map external acquisition channels
tasks.acceptance: Compare search, social, referral, newsletters and paid traffic.

tasks.title: Specify the acquisition funnel
tasks.acceptance: Define impressions, click-through, visits, leads, conversion and purchase.

tasks.title: Examine seasonality
tasks.acceptance: Compare like periods or mark the pattern unknown.

tasks.title: Track changes to distribution rules
tasks.acceptance: Date and source important ranking or policy updates.

queues.title: Competition and prices
queues.objective: Study the actual field and how sellers differentiate

tasks.title: Define comparable competitor sample
tasks.acceptance: Record sampling query, category, time and selection method.

tasks.title: Measure comparable price distributions
tasks.acceptance: Report sampled price ranges, currency and denominator.

tasks.title: Assess differentiating features
tasks.acceptance: Identify observable features without equating ratings with quality.

tasks.title: Assess reputation and incumbent advantage
tasks.acceptance: Study rankings, reviews, follower counts or legacy position.

tasks.title: Review buyer and creator switching costs
tasks.acceptance: Document lock-in, export, reviews and transferability.

tasks.title: Identify testable market gaps
tasks.acceptance: Write falsifiable needs and niche hypotheses.

queues.title: Income and outcome distribution
queues.objective: Measure actual participant earnings

tasks.title: Define earning-population denominator
tasks.acceptance: Separate all users, active sellers and paid sellers.

tasks.title: Find representative mean earnings
tasks.acceptance: Include amount, currency, period, sample and bias or mark unknown.

tasks.title: Find representative median earnings
tasks.acceptance: Include zero earners and method or mark unknown.

tasks.title: Document earnings percentiles
tasks.acceptance: Seek p10, p25, p75, p90 and top-tail evidence.

tasks.title: Study share earning zero
tasks.acceptance: State who is counted and why the measure may be biased.

tasks.title: Audit selection and survivorship biases
tasks.acceptance: Describe recruitment, response bias and missing populations.

tasks.title: Estimate effort-adjusted earnings
tasks.acceptance: Count production, marketing, administration and support time.

tasks.title: Separate sales, payout and net profit
tasks.acceptance: Define each economic quantity and all known expenses.

queues.title: Rights, products and portability
queues.objective: Understand ownership and legal terms

tasks.title: Check intellectual property terms
tasks.acceptance: Document license grants, owner rights and source dates.

tasks.title: Check exclusivity and restrictions
tasks.acceptance: State duration, geography and affected rights.

tasks.title: Document product acceptance and bans
tasks.acceptance: Identify current content/product rules with evidence.

tasks.title: Study portability of content and audience
tasks.acceptance: Record exports, email access, ratings and account limits.

tasks.title: Review dispute, appeal and takedown paths
tasks.acceptance: Document official procedures and timing.

tasks.title: Check rights to reuse research inputs
tasks.acceptance: Verify copyright, API and database licensing constraints.

queues.title: Sales, conversion and retention
queues.objective: Understand the customer transaction

tasks.title: Inspect listing and offer structure
tasks.acceptance: Document metadata, images, tags and pricing controls.

tasks.title: Trace sale or contract flow
tasks.acceptance: Describe transaction steps and who collects payment.

tasks.title: Study refunds and disputes
tasks.acceptance: Identify who bears losses and processing charges.

tasks.title: Document buyer feedback mechanisms
tasks.acceptance: Describe ratings, reviews, moderation and reputation transfer.

tasks.title: Study repeat and recurring purchases
tasks.acceptance: Define retention, subscriptions, renewal and churn measurements.

tasks.title: List seller analytics
tasks.acceptance: Identify reported conversion and traffic metrics, access and gaps.

queues.title: Risk, policy and continuity
queues.objective: Identify ways revenue and access can fail

tasks.title: Study suspension and termination
tasks.acceptance: Record policy grounds and appeals.

tasks.title: Document common fraud and payment risks
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish official warnings and independently observed incidents.

tasks.title: Track economically meaningful policy revisions
tasks.acceptance: Record version and effective date of rule changes.

tasks.title: Measure single-platform dependency
tasks.acceptance: Assess portable audience, payment and customer relationships.

tasks.title: Study privacy and data-access requirements
tasks.acceptance: Record official limits and risks to creator data.

tasks.title: Check country-specific compliance
tasks.acceptance: State sources and jurisdiction without invented legal advice.

tasks.title: Model continuity and exit options
tasks.acceptance: Document data export, payouts at closure and alternatives.

queues.title: Strategies and earning experiments
queues.objective: Find and test realistic ways to earn

tasks.title: Enumerate viable earning pathways
tasks.acceptance: Connect offering, audience, promotion, payment and fulfillment.

tasks.title: Compare neighboring marketplaces
tasks.acceptance: Use consistent cost, reach, rights and risk terms.

tasks.title: Model bounded revenue scenarios
tasks.acceptance: State assumptions; never invent likelihoods or expected earnings.

tasks.title: Calculate break-even conditions
tasks.acceptance: Include fixed costs, time, variable fees and refunds.

tasks.title: Specify testable offer experiments
tasks.acceptance: Define variant, cost, audience and evaluation threshold.

tasks.title: Specify acquisition experiments
tasks.acceptance: Measure traffic, conversions, time and cash costs.

tasks.title: Specify retention tests
tasks.acceptance: Define reorders, subscriptions, churn and horizon.

tasks.title: Write evidence-bounded recommendation
tasks.acceptance: State who may benefit, uncertainties, risks and next test.

queues.title: Verification and synthesis
queues.objective: Make findings reproducible and publishable

tasks.title: Finish public source register
tasks.acceptance: Every factual claim links to dated attributed public evidence.

tasks.title: Cross-check critical claims
tasks.acceptance: Use independent sources or document why cross-check unavailable.

tasks.title: Audit unknowns and comparability
tasks.acceptance: Inspect denominators, missing data and misleading comparisons.

tasks.title: Review all public artifacts
tasks.acceptance: Verify rights, privacy, neutral tone and data suitability.

tasks.title: Write the readable marketplace dossier
tasks.acceptance: Summarize fees, outcomes, barriers and uncertainty in plain English.

tasks.title: Validate index, dossier and queue references
tasks.acceptance: Ensure schema and gallery render checks pass.

tasks.title: Set a maintenance schedule
tasks.acceptance: Select review dates based on fee, policy and payout volatility.

queues.title: Video and streaming
queues.objective: Research conditions specific to video

tasks.title: Monetization thresholds and verification
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for monetization thresholds and verification.

tasks.title: Ad revenue measures and RPM denominators
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for ad revenue measures and rpm denominators.

tasks.title: Filming, production and streaming labor
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for filming, production and streaming labor.

tasks.title: Sponsorship, memberships, tipping and affiliate income
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for sponsorship, memberships, tipping and affiliate income.

tasks.title: Live attendance and evergreen content
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for live attendance and evergreen content.

queues.title: Platform population and use
queues.objective: Define how many people actually use the platform, in what ways, and where

tasks.title: Distinguish users, accounts, visitors and advertising reach
tasks.acceptance: Define numerator, denominator, eligibility and duplicate-account limits.

tasks.title: Estimate monthly active users
tasks.acceptance: Find dated MAU and geographic coverage, or record a documented unknown.

tasks.title: Estimate daily active users
tasks.acceptance: Find dated DAU, activity definition and uncertainty, or record unknown.

tasks.title: Measure advertising reach separately
tasks.acceptance: Separate addressable ad audience from active user or subscriber counts.

tasks.title: Map usage across countries
tasks.acceptance: Build country-level sourced distribution, dates, excluded regions and missing coverage.

tasks.title: Track population growth by region
tasks.acceptance: Create comparable historical series for countries and languages without mixing units.

tasks.title: Study device and access differences
tasks.acceptance: Source mobile, desktop, TV or other device mix and usage limitations.

tasks.title: Study duplicate users and cross-platform overlap
tasks.acceptance: Document account versus person counts and deduplication uncertainty.

tasks.title: Separate creators, uploaders, commenters, subscribers and viewers
tasks.acceptance: Define active consumption and active production populations independently.

queues.title: Audience demographics
queues.objective: Measure age and social composition at defined population and geographic levels

tasks.title: Describe age distributions
tasks.acceptance: Use consistent brackets and survey/analytics bases; never infer individuals' ages.

tasks.title: Describe reported gender distributions
tasks.acceptance: State self-report, platform classifications, nonresponse and category limitations.

tasks.title: Investigate sex breakdowns where independently supported
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish sex from gender and mark unmeasured or inapplicable categories unknown.

tasks.title: Research race and ethnicity where published and meaningful
tasks.acceptance: Use voluntary aggregate data, survey wording, jurisdiction and sample limits; no inference from appearance.

tasks.title: Break down geographic residence and reach
tasks.acceptance: Document top countries, share or counts, sampling design and dates.

tasks.title: Describe primary languages and multilingual audiences
tasks.acceptance: State measurement method and differences between language and country.

tasks.title: Find education distributions if available
tasks.acceptance: Use representative population-specific survey evidence or leave unknown.

tasks.title: Find socioeconomic and household income distributions
tasks.acceptance: Provide inflation/time, currency, age sample, country and survey limitations.

tasks.title: Document aggregate political affiliation if independently surveyed
tasks.acceptance: Use voluntary, aggregate surveys only; no inference of individuals' political identity or persuasion targeting.

tasks.title: Document aggregate religious identity only where robustly surveyed
tasks.acceptance: Apply local context and privacy limits; leave unsupported splits unknown.

tasks.title: Examine urban/rural and regional differences
tasks.acceptance: Source geographic classifications and survey sampling differences.

tasks.title: Examine credible demographic cross-tabulations
tasks.acceptance: Specify combinations, sample sizes and representativeness; do not multiply marginal percentages.

tasks.title: Audit demographic data access and bias
tasks.acceptance: Record nonresponse, login coverage, suppression, ad-reach modeling and age-report uncertainty.

queues.title: Subculture and topic atlas
queues.objective: Map communities and measure their audiences without adding overlapping totals

tasks.title: Define reproducible and revisable content-community taxonomy
tasks.acceptance: Specify inclusion rules, overlapping labels, aliases and cross-community tagging.

tasks.title: Research beauty, makeup and cosmetics communities
tasks.acceptance: Define the vertical and seek dated audience, channel, output and engagement estimates.

tasks.title: Research feminine lifestyle, fashion and girl-oriented content
tasks.acceptance: Separate adult women's content and material directed at girls/minors; document units and labels.

tasks.title: Research animation, including children's animation
tasks.acceptance: Separate all-ages animation from child-directed content and record audience-data restrictions.

tasks.title: Research political news, commentary and civic communities
tasks.acceptance: Define content categories with neutral sourcing; measure content, audiences and geography without persuasion profiling.

tasks.title: Research memes, humor and remix cultures
tasks.acceptance: Define platform-native formats, language and cross-topic overlaps.

tasks.title: Research gaming and live gaming communities
tasks.acceptance: Separate creators, viewers, games, viewers' countries and formats.

tasks.title: Map music, technology, education, fitness, finance and other sizable verticals
tasks.acceptance: Build an extensible taxonomy using public evidence, not a closed list.

tasks.title: Estimate audience size of each defined community
tasks.acceptance: Record metric type, geography, period, data access, assumptions and bounds for every figure.

tasks.title: Estimate number of active creators or channels per community
tasks.acceptance: Use a reproducible sampling strategy and distinguish active versus historical accounts.

tasks.title: Measure views, watch time, posts or live attendance per vertical
tasks.acceptance: Never substitute content counts for unique people or use raw search hits as exact census.

tasks.title: Measure or bound intersections between communities
tasks.acceptance: Record audience overlap and explain why community totals must not be summed.

tasks.title: Audit errors in community labeling and samples
tasks.acceptance: Check multilingual labels, ambiguous niches, unavailable private channels and sampling bias.

queues.title: Content formats and behavior
queues.objective: Study what audiences consume and which modes of content are growing

tasks.title: Map shorts, long-form, streams, audio, posts and other formats
tasks.acceptance: Define format availability, geography and population.

tasks.title: Measure watch time or attention by vertical
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish minutes, sessions, views and unique people.

tasks.title: Estimate creator publication cadence by community
tasks.acceptance: Study release frequency and variance in a defined creator sample.

tasks.title: Research retention and completion where publicly available
tasks.acceptance: Separate creator-owned analytics from publicly visible estimates.

tasks.title: Compare format consumption across devices
tasks.acceptance: Source differences by country, screen, bandwidth and period.

tasks.title: Research language and subtitling habits
tasks.acceptance: Record method and evidence on multilingual accessibility.

tasks.title: Measure cross-format and cross-vertical transitions
tasks.acceptance: Identify observable transitions without inventing audience-level attribution.

tasks.title: Study time zones and culturally specific posting patterns
tasks.acceptance: Use aggregated time and geography evidence, not individual monitoring.

queues.title: Social discovery and competition
queues.objective: Examine recommendations, community exposure and organic acquisition

tasks.title: Document the major discovery and subscription surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Use official platform documentation for recommendations, feeds, search and community features.

tasks.title: Research topic-level search interest
tasks.acceptance: Use disclosed trends and clearly bounded query samples, not exact search-count claims.

tasks.title: Document official ranking and distribution signals
tasks.acceptance: Separate confirmed descriptions from speculative creator lore.

tasks.title: Map publicly documented referral hubs and cross-promotion
tasks.acceptance: Study external referrals, public communities and related content paths.

tasks.title: Measure concentration among established accounts by vertical
tasks.acceptance: Sample visible creators with dates, method and concentration limits.

tasks.title: Investigate discovery for new or small creators
tasks.acceptance: Find credible cohort studies and separate new-creator results from top channels.

tasks.title: Separate paid reach, organic reach and creator partnerships
tasks.acceptance: Record comparable denominators and any disclosed costs.

tasks.title: Track changes in algorithmic and eligibility policy
tasks.acceptance: Record rule dates and affected content formats and regions.

queues.title: Community culture and participation
queues.objective: Understand norms, cross-community relationships and audience engagement

tasks.title: Identify public subculture communities and their definitions
tasks.acceptance: Source visible communities without scraping private memberships.

tasks.title: Record community norms and common formats
tasks.acceptance: Use public, attributable descriptions rather than stereotypes.

tasks.title: Compare comments, reactions and participation rates
tasks.acceptance: Normalize metrics by exposure where possible, date and methodology.

tasks.title: Study return visits and community loyalty
tasks.acceptance: Use appropriately scoped panel, survey or creator analytics, not fabricated retention.

tasks.title: Study livestream, forum and creator-community interactions
tasks.acceptance: Document platform-native social affordances and observable effects.

tasks.title: Study publicly expressed satisfaction and concerns
tasks.acceptance: Explain nonrepresentative sample limits and avoid private-person profiling.

tasks.title: Map audience movement and content overlap with other platforms
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish verified traffic from speculation and double-counting.

queues.title: Audience and community economics
queues.objective: Relate audience segments to viable content economics and creator workloads

tasks.title: Compare monetization models by content category
tasks.acceptance: Source actual available ads, subscriptions, product sales, tips and sponsorship mechanisms.

tasks.title: Investigate CPM or RPM distribution by geography and category
tasks.acceptance: Use credible samples; do not infer a platform-wide rate from exceptional channels.

tasks.title: Map public sponsor demand and brand-safety requirements
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish advertiser vertical, season, region and audience rules.

tasks.title: Compare production cost and effort by content format
tasks.acceptance: Define editing, research, labor, software, fulfillment and marketing inputs.

tasks.title: Trace content to subscribers, customers and sales
tasks.acceptance: Document plausible funnels and conversion evidence with dates.

tasks.title: Compare audience demand against creator supply by subculture
tasks.acceptance: Use consistent observation units and explicitly uncertain opportunity estimates.

tasks.title: Build audience-to-revenue sensitivity scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Expose assumptions for views, engagement, conversion, revenue splits and effort.

tasks.title: Specify ethical experiments for commercial content formats
tasks.acceptance: Define hypothesis, audience, measurement, spending limits and failure criteria.

queues.title: Subculture trends and shifts
queues.objective: Watch how community sizes, formats and economics change over time

tasks.title: Establish repeatable dated community-size series
tasks.acceptance: Do not treat changing API search estimates as an exact longitudinal census.

tasks.title: Find emerging communities and formats
tasks.acceptance: Document evidence threshold, sampling and uncertainty, not hype.

tasks.title: Identify shrinking or changing attention shares
tasks.acceptance: Use compatible historical categories and comparable time windows.

tasks.title: Study cyclical interest by country and topic
tasks.acceptance: Account for school calendars, major events and seasonal selection bias.

tasks.title: Compare demographic and interest shifts by region
tasks.acceptance: Use comparable survey or platform measurements and flag data revisions.

tasks.title: Study cross-platform cultural diffusion
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish first appearance, later adoption and audience migration.

tasks.title: Assess the reliability of niche-growth projections
tasks.acceptance: Explicitly document model assumptions, uncertainty and failed comparisons.

queues.title: Data limitations and audience safeguards
queues.objective: Keep audience research aggregate, reproducible and compliant

tasks.title: Inventory lawful official APIs, research reports and survey access
tasks.acceptance: Document access rights, rate limits, sampling, provenance and Terms compliance.

tasks.title: Verify aggregation and personal-data protections
tasks.acceptance: Exclude private profiling, scraped sensitive attributes and individual-level inference.

tasks.title: Assess child-directed content rules and analytics limitations
tasks.acceptance: Record child-audience restrictions; do not profile individual children.

tasks.title: Document neutral analysis boundaries for political audiences
tasks.acceptance: Permit descriptive aggregate research, not demographic-targeted political persuasion.

tasks.title: Review ad suitability and content-specific restrictions
tasks.acceptance: Record platform-specific policy revisions with dates.

tasks.title: Publish sensitivity ranges and data gaps
tasks.acceptance: Mark missing demographic and subculture estimates unknown with precise limitations.

tasks.title: Independent public evidence and taxonomy review
tasks.acceptance: Verify every number's denominator, date, labels, source and sample method.
